title: Knitting While Watching Movies Gains Popularity
titleZh: 边看电影边织毛衣日益流行
credits: Kiyoko Metzler reported this story for AFP from Vienna, Austria. Anna Matteo adapted it for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: Nearly 200 people in Vienna, Austria, gathered recently to enjoy two fun activities at the same time.
sentences.zh: 奥地利首都维也纳近200人近日聚集在一起，同时享受两项有趣的活动。

sentences.en: They worked with needles and yarn.
sentences.zh: 他们拿着针和毛线动手编织。

sentences.en: And they watched a movie together called The Devil Wears Prada.
sentences.zh: 同时一起观看了一部名为《穿普拉达的女王》的电影。

sentences.en: "It sounds a bit like a grandmother, but it's relaxing.
sentences.zh: “这听起来有点老太婆的味道，但很放松。

sentences.en: And…what's wrong with letting the grandmother in us express herself," joked Austrian Alexander Koch.
sentences.zh: 而且……让我们心中的那份‘老奶奶情怀’自由表达出来，又有什么不好呢，”奥地利人亚历山大·科赫打趣道。

sentences.en: He is a 28-year-old who crochets.
sentences.zh: 他是一名28岁的编织爱好者。

sentences.en: Knitting or crocheting while watching movies has gained popularity in Europe.
sentences.zh: 边看电影边织毛衣或钩针编织，在欧洲越来越流行。

sentences.en: Luisa Palmer was one of the organizers of the event.
sentences.zh: 路易莎·帕尔默是这次活动的组织者之一。

sentences.en: Palmer said that, during the COVID-19 pandemic, "A lot of people started knitting during the lockdown alone at home."
sentences.zh: 帕尔默说，在新冠疫情疫情期间，“很多人独自在家封锁期间开始织毛衣了。”

sentences.en: Palmer launched the knitting evenings once a month at Votiv Kino, a place to watch movies in the center of the Austrian capital.
sentences.zh: 帕尔默在维也纳市中心的电影院沃蒂夫电影院每月举办一次编织之夜活动。

sentences.en: "Now we need to find ourselves…" in real life, the 30-year-old told the French News Agency (AFP) before the event.
sentences.zh: “现在我们需要在现实生活中找回自己……”这位30岁的年轻人在活动前对法国新闻社（法新社）表示。

sentences.en: People are knitting, eating, or even breastfeeding babies while watching a movie.
sentences.zh: 人们在看电影时织毛衣、吃东西，甚至给婴儿喂奶。

sentences.en: This movement is the latest attempt to add different things to the movie-watching experience, said Lisa Stolze.
sentences.zh: 这项运动是试图为观影体验增添不同元素的最新尝试，丽莎·斯托尔泽说。

sentences.en: She is a spokesperson for Votiv Kino, the movie house.
sentences.zh: 她是这家电影院的发言人。

sentences.en: To avoid knitting mistakes, a soft light remains on during the movie.
sentences.zh: 为了避免织错，看电影期间会一直亮着柔和的灯。

sentences.en: This also helps to increase exchanges between the attendees.
sentences.zh: 这也有助于增加与会者之间的交流。

sentences.en: Organizers based their event on similar ones in the United States, Northern Europe, Germany and France.
sentences.zh: 组织者以美国、北欧、德国和法国的类似活动为蓝本举办此次活动。

sentences.en: Since launching in December of 2024, the movie events in Vienna are usually full.
sentences.zh: 自2024年12月启动以来，维也纳的电影活动通常座无虚席。

sentences.en: "I usually knit while watching movies or listening to podcasts at home, so movie theaters are the perfect place for this activity," said Kaja Vospernik.
sentences.zh: “我通常在家边看电影或听播客边织毛衣，所以电影院是这项活动的完美场所，”卡娅·沃佩斯尼克说。

sentences.en: She is a 23-year-old fashion student.
sentences.zh: 她是一名23岁的时尚专业学生。

sentences.en: As the movie plays, the colorful projects take shape.
sentences.zh: 随着电影放映，色彩缤纷的手工制品逐渐成形。

sentences.en: The film takes a back seat, meaning it is less important than the work of knitting or crocheting.
sentences.zh: 电影退居次要地位，也就是说它比编织或钩针编织的工作更重要。

sentences.en: Everyone shows off their work.
sentences.zh: 每个人都展示自己的作品。

sentences.en: Experienced knitters and crocheters help beginners learn new skills.
sentences.zh: 有经验的编织者和钩针编织者帮助初学者学习新技能。

sentences.en: "You can come alone and knit in silence to relax.
sentences.zh: "你可以独自前来，在沉默中编织以放松身心。

sentences.en: But if you are looking for company, this kind of event seems to me to be the right choice," said Judith Haslöwer.
sentences.zh: 但如果你想要有人陪伴，这种活动在我看来是理想的选择，"朱迪思·哈斯洛沃说道。

sentences.en: She is another organizer of the event.
sentences.zh: 她是该活动的另一位组织者。

sentences.en: People attend the events for several reasons.
sentences.zh: 人们参加这些活动有多种原因。

sentences.en: Some say the events let them reconnect with something real that is not on a computer.
sentences.zh: 有人说这些活动让他们重新连接到电脑之外某种真实的东西。

sentences.en: Others say they can “slow down a little.”
sentences.zh: 另一些人说自己可以"稍微慢下来"。

sentences.en: Palmer said, "Doing something with your ten fingers is still more rewarding…" than working at a computer all day.
sentences.zh: 帕尔默说："用你的十指做点事情，仍然比一整天都在电脑前工作更有意义……"

sentences.en: She added that picking the right movie is also important.
sentences.zh: 她补充说，选择合适的电影也很重要。

sentences.en: Palmer likes to watch a good "cozy comedy” that she has already seen.
sentences.zh: 帕尔默喜欢看一部她看过的很好的"温馨喜剧片"。

sentences.en: She joked that it is best to avoid scary movies.
sentences.zh: 她开玩笑说，最好避开恐怖片。

sentences.en: They can make you jump causing you to lose your place in your knitting.
sentences.zh: 它们会让你受惊，导致你忘记编织的进度。

glossary.def: a thin piece of steel that is used to repair or connect cloth (or in this context, two long knitting needles are used to loop yarn and work the material into knitted items)
glossary.zh: 针：用于缝纫或编织的细钢针

glossary.def: a thin line of cotton or wool that is thicker than thread and used to make kinds of clothing and things around the home
glossary.zh: 纱线：比线粗、用于制作衣物等的棉或毛线

glossary.def: something that eases tension and calms
glossary.zh: 令人放松的：缓解紧张、使人平静的

glossary.def: making clothing using a certain method and a special needle with a hook and yarn
glossary.zh: 钩针编织：用带钩的专用针和纱线制作衣物

glossary.def: to make cloth using yarn or thread
a kind of program that is listened to or watched using a device like a mobile phone or computer
glossary.zh: 播客：用手机或电脑收听收看的节目

glossary.def: related to making or selling popular clothing
glossary.zh: 时尚：与服装的制作或销售相关

glossary.def: causing a good feeling about something’s value or usefulness
glossary.zh: 值得的：使人感到某物有价值或有用的

glossary.def: a feeling of ease and warmth
glossary.zh: 舒适的：轻松温暖的感觉
